summary: v2food is a Sydney plant-based meat company (Surry Hills) that acquired US brand Daring Foods and took an Ajinomoto investment in 2025, then launched Daring in Australia via Woolworths in May 2026. Gareth Sprainger has been CFO since March 2024 in a venture-backed role spanning finance, legal, property and operations, and signed the SEC Form D for the Daring deal. The stack includes NetSuite, and the company is larger than the typical lean-team target.

claims.text: v2food's registered address in its SEC filing is Level 1, 104 Buckingham Street, Surry Hills NSW.
Gareth Sprainger is listed on LinkedIn as the current CFO of v2food, since March 2024.
In a January 2026 podcast Gareth is described as holding a venture-capital-backed CFO role spanning finance, legal, property and operations as the business scales.
claims.quote: he sits in a venture-capital-backed CFO role at V2Food, spanning finance, legal, property, and operations as the business scales.

claims.text: In August 2025 v2food acquired US brand Daring Foods and signed a tie-up with Ajinomoto.
claims.quote: V2Food has acquired vegan business Daring Foods for an undisclosed sum and signed a tie-up with Ajinomoto

claims.text: Gareth signed the SEC Form D (29 July 2025) covering preferred shares issued as consideration for the merger acquisition of Daring Foods, Inc.
claims.quote: the Issuer issued 11,826,000 shares of its preferred stock as consideration for the merger acquisition of Daring Foods, Inc.

claims.text: In May 2026 v2food launched the Daring brand in Australia through Woolworths.
claims.quote: launched the brand in Australia through Woolworths Group.

claims.text: LinkedIn's company profile lists NetSuite, Oracle, Shopify and Klaviyo in v2food's tech stack.
claims.quote: Tech Stack: css3, html5, mongodb, nodejs, adp, netsuite, oracle, facebook, gorgias, klaviyo, shopify

claims.text: In March 2026 CEO Tim York said v2food is now one of the largest players in the USA under the Daring brand plus a growing business in Asia and Africa.
claims.quote: now being one of the largest players in the USA under the Daring. brand, plus an important and growing business in the emerging markets of Asia and Africa

claims.text: Ajinomoto's release says v2food also runs a direct-to-consumer meals business.
claims.quote: v2food also operates a direct-to-consumer (D2C) business offering delicious and healthy meals

claims.text: Ajinomoto's release lists v2food at 143 employees, well above the account record headcount.

hooks.text: Gareth's January 2026 podcast describes a CFO role spanning finance, legal, property and operations; post-acquisition AU/US growth means close work competes with everything else on his plate.
Daring's Woolworths launch in Australia (May 2026) on top of the US business and Asia/Africa expansion adds reconciliation streams.
DTC meals business adds subscription and payment-gateway reconciliation.

risks.text: Larger, heavily funded group (143 staff per Ajinomoto, ~US$147M raised) on NetSuite; likely mid-market tooling and a finance team beyond the lean ICP.
Ajinomoto now on the cap table; finance priorities may centre on integration and investor reporting.

gaps: No post by Gareth himself on close or reconciliation.
No evidence of what DTC payout or reconciliation tools are used.

first.body:

I'm Dawoud, founder of Vert, which helps finance teams reconcile and cash code 2x faster with a traceable audit trail. How much of your month-end goes on reconciling before the analysis starts?
